products.description: The Artemis MK.I is a modular, form-fitting service harness inspired by traditional working-dog harness construction, re-engineered and retrofitted specifically for human wear. Built on a heavy-duty 1050D nylon chassis with breathable padded air-mesh lining, it pairs authentic K9 harness hardware and MOLLE webbing with an ergonomic, human-adapted shoulder and torso fit.

specs.title: 01 // Heavy-Duty K9 Chassis
specs.detail: Constructed from rugged 1050D nylon with a soft, breathable air-mesh lining, side MOLLE webbing rails, and a heavy-duty lower steel D-ring.

specs.title: 02 // Re-Engineered Shoulder Rigging
specs.detail: Re-angled vertical 1-inch webbing straps with dual welded metal D-rings and quick-release metal shoulder buckles eliminate collar pinch and upper chest flare.

specs.title: 03 // Segmented 6-Point Fit
specs.detail: Two-piece segmented back harness anchors naturally between the shoulder blades and across the lower ribs with 6-point strap adjustment and a centered hook-and-loop patch placard.
